title: Margaritaville Nashville Resort -Studio
description:
Nashville Club Resort- heart of downtown Nashville is just a few blocks from popular hot spots like Honky Tonk Highway, Broadway, Second Avenue and Music Row. You won't find a better place for "living life like a song!" The country music scene offers endless places to visit like the Johnny Cash Museum, the Country Music Hall of Fame® and Museum, BB King's Blues Club, the Grand Ole Opry©, Ryman Auditorium and more.

Guest access
Guests must check in at the front desk. Present valid photo i.d and credit card for incidentals. If you are going to check in after hours please notify your host in advance. If you need a late check out please ask your host the day before check-out.

Other things to note
Please follow CDC travel guidelines and procedures for covid testing prior to departure. Requirements are a negative viral covid test 1-3 days  prior to travel. 

Environmental fee runs $25-$38 per day ( varies by resort ). This is a Government fee that is surcharged on most Islands “tourist tax”  in additional to your stay fees. The Resort charges this fee to your room and normally puts a $250 hold on your card when you check in / refunding the difference at the end of checkout.
